name: TRIUMF
notes: Created by the precision-2 stream as the host of PiENu (pion decay) and TUCAN (ultracold-neutron EDM).

operator_text.quote: TRIUMF INC. is owned by a consortium of 21 Canadian member universities, comprising a broad and comprehensive network of academic partners that spans Victoria to Halifax.
operator_text.value: TRIUMF Inc., owned by a consortium of 21 Canadian member universities

summary.plain: Canada’s national particle accelerator centre, on the University of British Columbia campus in Vancouver. Founded in 1968, it hosts research in particle and nuclear physics, materials science and the life sciences.
summary.technical: TRIUMF (Vancouver, BC), Canada’s particle accelerator centre, established 1968 and owned by a consortium of 21 Canadian universities. In this Atlas it hosts the PiENu and TUCAN precision experiments.
